This Muradabad pulao is very tasty, delicious and aromatic. You can call this Muradabadi biryani too. Today we will make this recipe in a very easy way. So to make it, we will take a grinding jar first where we add...
Now we will grind it coarsely. If you have ready-made cumin powder and chili paste, then you can also add all three things separately. After grinding, we will add it to the chicken. Here I have taken 750 grams of chicken.
We will add a whole piece of jaipatri, two pieces of dalchini, a whole pod of badian flowers, or you can call them star anise, five to six cloves, a pinch of black pepper, and now we will add...
1.5 tablespoons of shahi jeera, if you want you can also add regular jeera, 1.5 tablespoons of coriander powder,
half a tablespoon of garam masala powder, and now we will add three tablespoons of ginger-garlic paste, five to six green chilies. You can slit them and add if you like. Now we will add two medium-sized tomatoes which I have cut into large pieces.
We will add one tablespoon of salt to this and now we need to mix all the ingredients well and marinate it in the fridge for at least an hour. Now take a pan, add half cup oil, and three medium...
Now we need to fry the onions on medium flame until they turn golden brown. We will set aside some fried onions for garnishing and add the remaining fried onions with the marinated chicken.
We need to cook this on medium-low flame for 15-20 minutes without adding any water as the chicken's own juices will soften it well. Now, 15-20 minutes have passed; we take off the lid...
Now we need to add water, I am adding 4.5 cups of water here because we took 2.25 cups of rice which is half a kilo of rice, so we are taking double the quantity of rice in terms of water. After adding water, we will keep it on high flame, as soon...
After adding the rice, we add one tablespoon of salt to this and cook it again on high flame. As soon as it boils, we put the lid on and let it cook on low flame for 10-15 minutes. After 15 minutes, remove the lid and now in this...
